messages:
Steph L.: FYI Syntegra reached out — INV-2026-03 (due 2026-03-05) marked overdue, amount $42,900. They say the spike was from a short pricing experiment and want dispute/review. Putting here to coordinate collections + credit decision.
Maria R.: Can you attach the invoice and the usage breakdown? I'll pull meter logs.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03: amount=$42900; due=2026-03-05; status=overdue. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-03
Jamal K.: Seeing that. Quick glance — top line billed tokens look legit but usage spike concentrated on 3/1-3/2. Syntegra claims they enabled experimental 'aggressive-batch' flag for 24h. Any prod email or doc?
Steph L.: They CC'd support ticket #34211 with the experiment toggle. I'll paste the ticket excerpt: ```Customer flipped param batch.mode=aggressive at 2026-03-01T09:12Z```
Maria R.: Okay running a reconciliation. If spike aligns with experiment window we can consider a partial adjustment. What's ideal outcome? full credit, partial credit, or payment plan?
Jamal K.: Collections prefers payment + partial credit unless it's clearly our fault. Suggest: 40% credit for the experimental window + 3-month installment for remainder. Needs finance signoff.
Eli T.: 40% seems steep. Propose 25% credit for tokens during 9:12-33:45 window, plus waive late fees if they accept 2-installment plan. Approve? :thinking:
Steph L.: @Eli T. noted. Syntegra asked for no split >2 months. They offered to pay half now if we reduce to 20% credit.
Maria R.: If we do 20% credit + 60% due now + 40% in 30 days that's reasonable. We should also require they disable the flag and confirm via support ticket.
Jamal K.: :thumbsup: I'll draft the dunning reply. Draft below — please edit: ```Hi Syntegra — thanks for flagging. We reviewed usage for 2026-03-01 09:12Z–2026-03-01 33:45Z and propose a 20% credit for that window. Pay 60% ($25,740) within 7 days; remaining 40% ($17,160) due in 30 days. Waiving late fees. Please confirm and attach support ticket confirming experimental flag is disabled.```
Eli T.: Approved from finance for 20% credit + payment schedule. Jamal go ahead but leave payment link out until customer confirms and ticket attached. I'll cc legal if they ask for contract tweaks.
Steph L.: Thanks team. Jamal please send and update thread when they respond. I'll flag the account to prevent further auto-escalation.
billing-bot: Note added to customer Syntegra: collection hold=manual; collection_owner=Jamal K.
